body.statement: If \(\mu_{cx}=a_c+b_x\) on \(E_+\), every selector has \(\theta_h=\sum_cp_ca_c+\sum_xr_xb_x\). Under full support this reduces to the standard version-irrelevance case in which changing a calibrated conditional version law cannot change the macro mean.
body.justification: The reduction checks the criterion against a familiar special case.
body.gap: The additive identity is classical; its use here is a sanity reduction for the selector envelope.
body.consumer: It gives a transparent empirical-table validation check.
